---
title: "Group members"
description: "Current members and alumni of Tristan Bereau's group at the Institute for Theoretical Physics, Heidelberg University."
# Without this a listing page inherits its first item's image, so sharing
# the group page showed one alumnus's headshot as if it stood for the group.
image: /static/membrane.jpg
listing:
  contents: group
  categories: unnumbered
  # A grid of uniform cards rather than full-width rows. The photos are
  # supplied at whatever size and aspect ratio each person sent -- from
  # 270x358 to 3024x4032 -- and `type: default` rendered them unconstrained,
  # so a single portrait could stand taller than the viewport and page one
  # alone ran to eleven screens. `image-height` crops every card to the same
  # box, which is what makes the rows line up.
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 3
  image-height: 240px
  # 40 members, so a 25-item default page would split the group in two.
  page-size: 48
  fields: [image, title, categories]
  sort:
    - title
---
